land_pattern.notes: Read by the P3 librarian off the vendor drawing's 'PCB 图 (仅做参考)' recommended land pattern (HOOYA USB-111FD-B-SU, rev 230423, single-page PDF fetched from the wmsc.lcsc.com direct link in parts.json). 5 SMD signal lands: 0.40 wide x 1.20 long, pitch 0.65, total 5-pad span 2.60 (= 4 x 0.65, self-consistent). 2 round shield holes dia 0.70 spaced 4.85 apart. 2 oval shield slots 1.30 x 0.50 (pad width 1.10) spaced 7.20 apart. pad_count 9 = 5 signal + 4 shield lands (LCSC 'Number of Contacts 5P' counts signal contacts only). Vertical (row-to-row) dimensions on the drawing (2.13 / 4.60 / 5.30) are vector art at a resolution that does not read reliably - NOT used here; the footprint's own row spacing is 2.68 mm centre-to-centre between the round-hole row and the oval-slot row.
